The limit is the edge of how far something can go. It can go up to the limit but no farther.
To make something stay inside a limit.
If you limit someone, you reduce or take away their freedom.
ordinal twentieth) The number 20.
A twenty is a 20 dollar bill.
"Twenty" is short for 10-20, meaning location.
ordinal thirtieth) The number 30.
The scope of a book, a law, a duty, etc. is how much is included or how far it can go.
A scope is an instrument for looking at things, e.g., a telescope or a microscope.
If you scope something (out), you look at it carefully.
If you enhance something, you make it bigger or better.
If you have control over someone or something, you can make it do what you want.
A control is a button, switch, dial, etc. that lets you make a machine do what you want.
If you control something, you make it do what you want.
If something is high, it is a long way up.
If something is high, its top is a long way up.
If something is high, it is very good. It might be better or more important than other things. This can often means someone has more power.
A lead is a wire or strap attached to something.
Lead is a very heavy gray metal. It's a chemical symbol is Pb.
Someone is leading other people if the person is going first and the other people are following or coming after.
A written record of a saying or action of the Prophet Muhammad. Used as a basis for conduct in Islamic practices.
Insurance is an agreement where someone pays a small amount of money, and if something bad happens, they get money to help them.
An instrument is any thing people hold in their hand and use to do something.
An instrument is something used to play music.
To grow; to become bigger.
The amount which something has grown.
An industry is a kind of work that makes things.
Industry is the quality of working hard, trying hard and doing it well.
Humor is ideas that make people laugh: jokes, funny things.

The word how is used to ask about the way something happens or the way people do things.
The word how is used to tell about the way something happens or the way people do things.
The word how is used to show that you feel strongly about something.
A horn is a long, sharp thing that grows on the head of some animals such as goats and sheep.
A horn is a musical instrument that you blow and usually made of metal.
When someone hopes that something will happen, it means that they want it to happen and they think it may happen.
A hope is the idea in someone's mind when they're hoping for something.
A hook is a curved, sharp thing, usually made of metal and often small. Someone can put the hook through a hole in something to grip it so that they can pull the thing.
If you are hooking something, you are attaching it to a hook.
History is what happened in the past.
History is the study of what happened in the past.
If somebody or something makes history, they do something very important that will not be forgotten.
If you help another person do something, you do things to make it easier for them to do the thing, or you do part of it for them.
If you can't help doing something or can't help but do it, you cannot avoid it. You do it even without wanting or planning to.
Help is the act of helping.
A healthy person is someone who is not sick. They are strong and will probably live a long time.
Healthy things leads to better health.
A harbor is some water in a curve of land where it's safe for boats because there are no big waves.
To provide a harbor or safe place for something or someone.
To take refuge or shelter somewhere.
A drop is a very small amount of a liquid.
A drop is the fall of something.
To fall, or to let something fall.
Heat is a kind of energy. It is the quality things have when they are warm or hot.
To make something hot.
A gun is a weapon that sends bullets through its metal tube.
To make an engine work fast by opening its throttle.
If someone is gunned down, they are shot by something, usually a gun.

A garden is a place where flowers and other plants grow where people want them to. Frequently it is a small place with a wall around it, near a house. It may have rocks and other things in it to look beautiful.
If you garden, you work in a garden, especially your own garden around your house.
When something is from someone, the person gave or sent it.
When someone is from a place, that's where they started.
You use from to talk about distances between thing in space or time.
The existence of a thing is the quality of being real, of being in the world, of just being.
Usual; about most things. An idea is a general idea if it's about many things or about most things, not just about one specific thing.
General is approximate, not exact; maybe a little different; close but maybe not the same.
A general is the leader of an army.

If you give something to someone else, you had the thing and you let the other person have it. Maybe you use your hands to put the thing in the other person's hands. Usually after that, the thing is the other person's thing.
If you give a speech, you talk to a group of people.
To move towards a place or into a place; to move to the place where the person who is talking is.
When something happens or arrives.
If you go, you move in space, especially to or through a place.
If you go, you move in time, often in your mind.
If you go, you move on the computer, the internet, or in the memory.
A clear idea is an idea that is easy to understand.
If it is clear that something is a certain way, there can be no mistake about it.
If you are clear about something, you understand it well.
Something that is covering another thing is on top of (or over) the other thing in a way that stops people from seeing it.
A cover is something that usually covers something else.
When something cracks it breaks along a line, maybe not a straight line. It might break into two pieces, or it might break but the two pieces are still attached.
A crack is the line where something is breaking.
A loud sound like the sound of something breaking.
Someone grips a thing by holding it tightly in their hand.
A hold or a way of holding something
A handle or a place to grip.
A bassist is someone who plays a bass instrument or sings bass.
A nobody is a person who is not important.
Humour is ideas that make people laugh: jokes, funny things.
To humour someone is to agree with them only to make the them happy.
A harbour is some water in a curve of land where it's safe for boats because there are no big waves.
To provide a harbour or safe place for something or someone.
To take refuge or shelter somewhere.
If x incorporates y, y is part of x.
If you incorporate x into y, you make x part of y.
An incorporated company is a corporation. Often written Inc. as part of a company name.

If you give something to someone else, you had the thing and you let the other person have it. Maybe you use your hands to put the thing in the other person's hands. Usually after that, the thing is the other person's thing.
Given x means if x is true, happened, exists, etc.
Given that-clause means in consideration of the fact that-clause.
A subsidiary is a company that is owned by a larger company. {[ant|parent}}
If something is subsidiary, it is connected, but lower in importance, rank, or level, etc.
The input is the information that is put into something.
If you input something (often into a computer) you put it in.
If something is abstract, you cannot touch it, and it is difficult to imagine or think about.
If something is abstract, it is general.
If something is abstract, it is thought of as apart from any other use with an object; it is removed from it; it is separate or abstracted.
If someone or something is capable of something, they can do it.
If someone is capable, they can do a particular thing well.
Someone is learning ideas if they didn't know the ideas before and they are starting to know them.
Learning is the action of someone learning something.
Someone has something if the thing is in their hands. The person is holding or gripping it.
If you have to do something, you must do it.
Someone has something if the thing is that person's thing: the person owns it; it belongs to the person.
A gal is a girl or woman.
Gal is an abbreviation for gallon, which is a unit of measurement for volume.
If you save something, you keep it; you do not give it or toss it away.
If you save someone, you keep them safe or help them survive.
If you save information, you put it on a disk or into some kind of long-term memory.
When you sell something to someone, you give something to someone and the person will give you money for it.
To hear and then fully know what was said, know enough to do it. To know the meaning of something.
A person moves a comb through their hair many times to make their hair look nice.
To move a comb through hair.
To look carefully for something.
A container is full of things if there are many of the things in the container and no more can go in.
A full moon is when the moon is a round circle because the sun is shining on the side we can see.
A person is full when they are satisfied, usually with food.
The destruction of a thing is the act of breaking the thing; the end of existence of the thing. Before the destruction, the thing is there. After the destruction, there is no thing any more.
to come before.
A display is an exhibition, an arrangement, or a show.
A display is a computer screen.
If you display something, you arrange it so that people can see it. Display means to exhibit, or to show.
Two people are friends of each other if they like being together and they like helping each other, but are not related.
A cushion is a pillow; a soft item that people can sit on or put their head on when they lie down.
To stop one item from making hard contact with another item.
My favourite brand is the brand I like most.
A favourite is a thing or person that someone likes the most. It is a thing that someone prefers, or likes more than any other.
When kings and other royalty have favourites, these are people they trust.
If you express yourself, you say something about how you feel.
An incentive is something that makes you feel like you want to do something.
When someone makes a comparison between two things, the person thinks about how the two things are the same and how they are different, which one is bigger etc.
An inhibition is a feeling that makes you want to avoid (stay away from) something.
Inhibition is the act of stopping or reducing a process, especially a natural or chemical process.
A curve is a line that is not straight. It is like part of a circle. It starts in one direction and turns.
To move in a curve.
Copper is a metal that is a red-brown colour. Sometimes coins of small value are made from copper. The symbol for copper is Cu with an atomic number of 29.
A copper is a penny, a coin of small value made of copper.
A copper is a police officer.
The floor is the flat part at the bottom of a room. People stand on the floor.
A floor is a level of a building.
: This short section needs someone to add to it.
A trace of something is a very small amount, almost too small to find.
A trace is a line on a paper drawn by a machine that shows the ups and downs of something.
A trace is a path that tells you where something came from.
An exchange is when a person or a group of people trade an item or service with another person or group of people.
An exchange is the act of exchanging.
The distance between two things is how far apart they are. A short distance means they're close to each other, and a long distance means they're far apart.
If you distance yourself from someone, you move away from something or someone.
Flight is the act of flying: moving through the air using wings.
A flight is a trip on an airplane.
Flight is the act of running away and hiding.
The part you can see in fire.
A flame is a lover that only lasts for a short time.
A flame is a strong comment on the internet to insult (hurt) someone else, making them angry.
To have a fear of someone or something means to be scared of someone or something; to be afraid of someone or something.
Fear is the chance that something might happen.
Fear is a feeling of very high respect, usually towards a god.
Unwise. A person who is foolish does not have good sense or judgement. They do things without thinking carefully; they do things that are bad ideas.
Foolish means someone who is usually foolish. They have the characteristic (quality) of being foolish.
When something or someone falls, it moves down quickly down through the air because nothing is holding it. It moves to a lower position because of gravity.
When someone falls, they can mean coming down to the ground on purpose, lying with the face down.
Falling is when someone or something has been defeated.
A fan is a thing that moves air to help people stay cool; either a small paper thing a person holds in their hand, or a machine with a part that turns fast to push the air.
A fan is a person who supports another person or team.
To blow air on something, often with a fan.
If you fold something thin such as paper, you bend it so it touches itself.
In poker, if you fold, you stop betting and withdraw.
If you fold on ingredient into another, you stir it gently and carefully with a folding action.
Form is the shape or structure of a person or a thing.
A thing that makes shapes to other things, as in a mold.
A form is a blank document which is to be filled in by a person.
A delicate thing is something that can break easily. It is usually beautiful but people need to be careful if they touch it.
A detail is a small part of something that is not as important as the whole thing.
A detail is a job or duty.
When someone details something, they tell all the details about it, or record the details.
When two people fight against each other, they hit each other and try to hurt each other.
When two people fight against each other, they want different things and they try to get what they want. They might yell, or they might just try hard.
A fight is when people are fighting.
An event is frequent if it happens many times in a short time.
Someone frequents a place if they go there regularly.
The incidence of something is how often it happens.
If you hear something, you use your ears to get a sound from it.
The act of hearing or the quality of being able to hear.
A trial in a court of law or another kind of event where a group listens to people and makes a formal decision.
A fowl is a bird: an animal with feathers that can fly, especially a kind that people eat.
Something that is feeble is very weak.

A parenthesis is a symbol that looks like ( or ). A person may see parentheses when reading books. Most of the time, they are not used to tell the main story, but gives the reader extra information so they can understand.

A massacre is when many people are killed. This is especially true when those killed appear to be innocent civilians not linked to the war in progress. Very often, the term is also applied if the killings were done in a brutal way.
To kill many innocent people without much resistance; to slaughter people.
Something is elastic if it can stretch or bend and go back to the way it was.
In a cooperative effort, project, etc., a number of people work together to do something.
If someone is cooperative, they listen and try to help or work with you.
A cooperative is a type of business that is owned by the people working there or by its customers.
If you reveal something, it was hidden and you show it or make it known.
An index is an alphabetical (A to Z) list, usually at the back of a book, where you can find the pages in a book that talk about particular things or words.
An index shows the level of prices, wages, etc. so you can compare them with those of an earlier date.
If you index something, you make an index (guide) for it.
Discrimination is the act of treating someone unfairly just because of their skin colour, religion, sex, etc.
Discrimination is the ability to notice differences.
Discrimination is the ability to recognise high levels of quality.
If something is overseas, it is in a different country, usually across the ocean.
The overseas markets, students, etc. are in or from a different country, usually across an ocean.
Something that goes against the rules in a sport.
Bad, or having a bad smell.
An event is anything that happens.
An event is when many people come together at a time they choose for a reason or for fun.
A drain is a hole, sometimes in the bottom of a basin, to let water flow out, and a pipe attached to the hole.
Someone drains something when they take the water or other liquid out of it.
A drawer is a box made of wood that is part of a piece of furniture (such as a desk); drawers can slide in and out so that people can put things into them.
A drawer is a person who draws.
A person who writes a bank draft, check, or promissory note.
A company is an organization for doing work for money.

Company is people who are visiting other people; people who are in other peoples' house so that they can talk to the other people, or people who are walking with other people or being somewhere with other people.
When someone keeps someone else company, they stay with the person.
A force is the act of a thing pushing on another thing, or how strongly it pushes.
A group that aims to attack, control, or constrain.
Someone forces something to happen when they make it happen.
Someone who is cruel is mean. They hurt other people and don't care, or they like hurting other people.
An action is cruel if only cruel people would do it.
A miner is a person who works in a mine. They go into a deep tunnel in the earth to get diamonds, coal, silver, gold or other minerals.
You use x minus y to show that y is taken away from x.
A minus is a problem or some negative aspect.
A nephew is the male child of someone's sister or brother, and is a part of their extended family.
You need justice when you have been treated unfairly, cheated, hurt, or denied your basic rights by others.
Justice means fairness in how people are treated and how rules are applied. It is the idea that everyone should get what they truly deserve.
If something is explicit, it is clearly said or shown, not hidden or just suggested.
The aggregate is the number or amount when everything is put together.
Aggregate is the small stones that are used to make concrete.
If you aggregate something, you put or bring it together.
A flag is a piece of cloth, usually marked with a colourful symbol or sign.
A flag flown by a ship is to show the presence on board of the admiral (the leader of a group of ships); the admiral himself; or his flagship.
The use of a flag, especially to show the start of a race or other event.
A living thing's gender is its sex: male (man, boy), female (woman, girl), both, or neither.
Gender is a way of grouping nouns in some languages, for example: masculine, feminine & neuter.
Someone's gender is whether they behave like a boy or girl. This is called masculine or feminine, and not the same as male or female.
If x underlies y, x causes y; x is the reason for y.
If x underlies y, x is the basis for y or the most important part of y.
If something is brief, it is for a short time.
If a piece of clothing such as shorts or a skirt is brief, it is short.
A brief is a short piece of writing or a short talk.
Dear is something that is precious or greatly valued to someone. They love the thing or the person.
Dear is something very expensive. It has a higher price; costs a lot of money.
A kind, loving person.
A domain is a field or area of knowledge or skill, or of where a rule is in force.
A domain is a large area owned by a person or controlled by a government.
A domain (name) is a group of internet addresses or URLs that share the same last section (e.g., http://simple.wiktionary.org/wiki/domain is in the wiktionary.org domain.)

A sacrifice is something that a person gives up in order to help him or somebody else. A person who makes a sacrifice for a friend will do something that he might not want to do in order to help his friend.
A sacrifice is an offer given as a gift to a god.
If you sacrifice someone or something, you give them up for other things.
If something is rational, it makes sense and is based on reason.
If someone is rational, they are calm and not emotional.
An outer piece of clothing that covers the upper part of the body and the arms.
A covering of material, such as paint.
The fur or feathers of an animal.
The parts of a building that are strong and that hold the other parts up.
The strong parts (bones) of a person's body.
Something, often made of wood, around the outside of a picture.
A condition is a logical clause or phrase that a conditional statement uses. The phrase can either be true or false.
The health status of a medical patient.
A problem, especially a medical problem.
Kidney is an organ that is part of the human body. It cleans the blood and makes urine (pee) which is the dirty water that needs to leave the body.
The organ that does the same thing in the body of other animals.
Division is the act of dividing a whole thing into parts.
Division is the process or calculation of dividing a number by another number.
Divisions are the parts of something after division.
If you close something, you change it from being open to not open.
If something closes, it goes out of business for a short time or permanently.
If the distance or time between two different things closes, they get closer together.
When a person fixes something, they repair it.
When something is fixed, it didn't work before, but now it works; when something has been repaired.
If an animal has been fixed, it had an operation to stop it from having babies.
We measure an angle using degrees. All the way around a circle is 360 degrees. Often, ° is written instead of "degrees".
We measure how hot or how cold it is (temperature) using degrees on a scale, such as Celsius or Fahrenheit.
The amount that an object has of a certain quality.
The act of growing (getting bigger); an increase in size, number, value, or strength.
Something that grows or has grown; a mass that is not normal, such as a tumor.
A strong dislike someone feels for something. Disgust is an emotion. People feel it, for example, when they find something dirty or not fit to eat.
To cause a strong dislike for something.
If you are dependent on something, you need it or rely on it.
A dependent is a person who relies on another person for support.
A dependent is an element in a phrase or clause that is not the head.
If you drive a car or other vehicle, you control its movement and direction.
If something is driving, it is moving quickly and strongly.
someone or something that guides.
a document or book that offers information or instruction; guidebook.
a sign that guides people; guidepost.
Something which has developed
A real estate development.
Using new ideas for practical problems.
The minimum is the lowest number, size, amount, etc. that exists, that is allowed, or that is possible.
A distance in space or in time.
In music, an interval is the difference in pitch between two notes.
In mathematics, an interval is a connected section of the real line.
A rigid object does not bend.
fixed rather than moving
rigorous and unbending
Flexibility is the quality of being able to give yourself a blowjob.
An author is the creator of a work; a writer.
An author is a source of information.
If you author something, you create a work as its author.
If you have or take the initiative, you are in control and can decide what to do next.
If you have initiative, you do things without needing to be told to do them.
An initiative is an effort to start doing something to solve a problem.
If something will happen eventually, it will happen but it will be in the future, not soon. Some day it will happen.
An event that is forthcoming is something that will happen soon. It's coming in a short time.
A person who is forthcoming is someone who tells what they're thinking.
When something is crucial, it is very important. It will make a big difference. You cannot succeed without it.
An allocation is the amount that is given out or shared.
Allocation is the act of giving out or sharing something.
If x exceeds y, x is or becomes larger or better than y.
If you exceed something, you go beyond (farther than) the limits, beyond the regular level or beyond what is allowed.
An intervention is an activity designed to change or stop a situation.
Someone is definite if they are sure. They have no doubt about what they're saying.
Something is definite if it has defined limits.
An identified person or thing
Acting of one's own free will. Something that somebody does is voluntary if the person is doing it because they want to do it, not because someone orders them to do it.
Working without payment.
If someone releases something, they let go of it; they stop holding it and set it free (let it be free).
Someone releases something when they put it out into the world (discharge it).
A company releases something when they let the public start using it.
Wealth is when one has a lot of money. Wealth is a lot of money or a lot of things of high value like land, houses, factories, jewelry, etc.
A holy war is a war fought for religious reasons. Examples include jihad and crusades.

Something collapses when all its parts fall down loosely. A building or a bridge collapses when it breaks and all its parts fall down. A person collapses when they are tired and they fall into a chair or onto a bed and are too tired to get up.
The act of collapsing.
A colleague is a person who works together with another person or who does the same kind of work.
If you levy a charge or a tax, you legally make people pay it.
A levy is an extra charge on top of the basic price, usually a tax.
Someone drafted or conscripted into military service.
When x is true, and nonetheless y is true, then x being true didn't stop y from being true.
Integrity is the quality of being honest and of doing only good things.
Integrity is the quality of being whole, not broken.
Tonight is the night that comes between today and tomorrow.
The second thing is the one that is number two (2) in order.
A second serving of food for one person.
Seconds is the present third person singular of second.
Today is the current day, the day that is happening now, the day between yesterday and tomorrow.
Today is modern times; the present in general.
Too means to a higher degree than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively.
Too means in addition; also.
An ordinal number, scale, or variable gives the order.
An ordinal number such as first, second and third.
A group of people who came together for an event.
The act of people or things coming together.
The act of making something by putting parts together.
If x has adjacent y, there is no other thing between x and y.
If x is adjacent to y, there is no other thing between x and y.
A small coin of little value, also called a penny; 100 cents make a dollar.
If something is straightforward, it is simple. It is easy to understand and easy to know how to do it.
Huge; very big; very large.
x is intrinsic to y if x is an important part of y. y must always have x as a part.
The time something takes, or how much time it takes.
by which; because of which
Someone has an inclination to do something if the person wants to do it or often does it.
Something has an inclination if it's on a slant or angle.
The fifth thing is something that is number five (5) in order.
A fifth of something is one of five equal parts of that thing.
A fifth of an alcoholic drink is a bottle of it.
A user is someone who uses something.
A user is someone with an account and username that lets them log in to a computer and do things on the computer.
A motto is a favorite phrase or saying, often telling a principle or belief. Individuals and groups can have mottos.
A protocol is a rule, guideline, or document about how certain activities are done.
A protocol is a set of rules that describes how data is transmitted.
Something overlaps on another thing if part of it is on top of, or at the same time as, the other thing.
The act of overlapping. The amount that two things overlap on each other.
Someone attains a status if they reach it and start to have that status.
A sphere is a shape that is round in all directions, like a ball. Every point on a sphere is the same distance from the centre (a point in the middle) of the sphere.
A route is the way someone goes from one place to another place.
To send something or someone on a specific route.
Arrogance is an attitude that someone may have that he/she is better than other people.
The background is what can be seen or heard behind other things that are closer or louder.
The background of a person is his/her history.
To make a background.
If you blank something, you make it empty.
If a piece of paper or something else is blank, it has nothing written on it.
A blank is a space or line on a piece of paper or somewhere else where a word or phrase is supposed to be.
When there is a controversy about something, people don't agree about it and there is a lot of talking about it.
A simulation of an event is when people make something that looks like the event happening, but it isn't real.
A part of something that is natural and cannot be separated from it.
Period from midday to sunset.
Very bad. So bad that people don't want to think about it.
When two people agree about something, they have the same ideas. They both think the same things are true.
When two people agree to do some things, they say something like "if you do this, then I will do that." After they agree, then they must do the things they said.
When something moves away from something else, the distance between them gets bigger. They are no longer near or close.
If Dan is arrogant, he thinks he is better or more important than other people.
Somebody who is deaf, cannot hear or cannot hear well.
Someone with deafness cannot hear or cannot hear well.
A niece is the female child of someone's sister or brother and is a part of their extended family.
A partisan is a person who is a supporter of a political party, or of an idea. He or she may also be militant, ready to use force to fight for his or her cause.

Savoury means "not sweet". Food that is savoury does not taste sweet. The savoury course of a meal may have meat or fish and vegetables. This may be followed by a sweet course (called "pudding" or "dessert").
"Savour" can also mean the characteristic taste of something. It can also mean to enjoy something: "He savoured every moment of it".
To purge an organization or an object means to clean it up of something bad.
When a purge occurs, an organization or an object is cleaned up of something bad.
If something is visible, it can be seen.
If something is finite, it has a limit. It doesn't keep going forever.
Publication is the act of making a book or other thing publicly known or available where the public can use it.
A publication is a book, magazine, paper, song, etc. that has been or will be published.
A disturbance is an uneasy feeling.
To disturb means to stop someone or something by interrupting them.
Clumsiness is a lack of coordination; it is the condition of being clumsy.
A thesis is a long paper that university students at the masters or doctoral level write.
A thesis is a main idea or argument that is developed or explained.
A knife is a tool that cuts.
If you set something somewhere, you put something into a place.
If you set something, you put it into some state or condition.
If you set something, you define it or to fix its value.
A dull yellowish-brown color, the color of dust.
A strong cloth that is made of wool or cotton; khaki is often used for making military uniforms.
When someone invokes a rule, they use the rule in a specific situation.
When someone invokes a rule, they use the rule in a specific situation.
When a rule is invoked, it is being used in a specific situation.
When someone does something likewise, they do it the same way someone else did it. Sometimes people say likewise to mean that they're saying the same thing someone else just said.
When someone uses the word "so-called" to talk about something, they mean that other people talk about the thing that way, but they don't agree.
If something is brilliant, it gives off a lot of light.
If something is brilliant, it is very good.
If a person is brilliant, they are very intelligent.

(Note that all accents of English pronounce the rhotic sound if "r" or "rh" is immediately followed by a vowel – which means it is always pronounced at the start of a word.)

If a dialect (form of a language) or accent is non-rhotic, it only pronounces the rhotic sound for the letter R when it is before a vowel (more precisely, the rhotic sound is pronounced if "r" or "rh" is immediately followed by a vowel – which also means it is always pronounced at the start of a word).
